Set A's main faults are one misbound force (2900 g labeled as martensite) and two claims attaching the 15-20 C Irvine ambient range to the building envelope or the wire specification, along with a few trivial diagram-label claims. Both sets contain duplicated and trivial claims, but A is clearly more accurate.
